name: Counsel for a settlement
goals: Keep a channel open for talks while court opinion shifts.
Reassess which petitions survive the change of Bendahara.
bio: A hearing can buy time, but a change of Bendahara does not transfer the old household’s obligations. The admiral who advises talks is not named here.
notes: fact: Brown names Mutahir’s successor, and Pires has the Bendahara and admiral counsel peace in 1511 without naming them in that passage (Brown ch. XXII, p. 164; Pires II, p. 280)
inference: The succession makes Pikrama a plausible match, not a named attribution by Pires (people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: A temporary negotiating contact, not a party with a fixed membership (people-factions.md §3)
